articles.title: A familiar Iranian hacking group has found a new way to cause chaos
articles.summary:
One night in October, hackers staged one of the most unusual cyber attacks in history: cranking up the temperature in refrigeration systems at hundreds of supermarkets across France and destroying millions of euros of food.
Hackers have targeted commercial fridges and freezers before, but never at this scale and never in the heart of Europe. The brazen attack left cyber professionals unsure as to who might have executed such a madcap operation. But French intelligence agencies found traces of Farsi and other clues in the digital trail pointing to an elite hacking unit of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
The unit allegedly behind the hack, Shahid Kaveh, was already well known to Western intelligence agencies. Named after Mahmoud Kaveh, an Iranian commander who died during the 1980s Iran-Iraq war, it is one of several hacking units overseen by the Revolutionary Guards’ Cyber Electronic Command.
The group, which often goes by the online persona CyberAv3ngers, has a history of targeting critical infrastructure. In 2023 and 2024, it hacked Israeli-made industrial control devices inside water, manufacturing, and transportation systems across several US states. Operational disruption was minimal, but the attackers left a message each time: “Every equipment ‘made in Israel’ is CyberAv3ngers legal target.”
State-backed Iranian hackers have rarely targeted Europe in this way, however. October’s hacks, experts say, mark an escalation in the Islamic republic’s cyber warfare strateg…

Lo que sí ha mencionado es que en ninguno de los casos se ha vulnerado las contraseñas o claves secretas almacenadas en el servicio.

articles.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing US trade secrets, but cleared of racketeering

The big picture: Washington has spent the better part of a decade calling Huawei a threat, though mostly via bans and blacklists rather than in a courtroom. On Tuesday, a jury finally got its say, and the result was split. Jurors in Brooklyn found the company guilty of conspiring to steal trade secrets from American rivals. But they acquitted Huawei of the racketeering charge that was supposed to tie the whole case together.
Huawei was convicted on 10 of the 12 counts it faced after a trial that ran about 11 weeks. Along with the trade secret conspiracy, those counts included bank fraud, wire fraud, money laundering, and sanctions violations linked to its business in Iran. The jury acquitted it of racketeering conspiracy and of conspiring to obstruct justice.
Losing the racketeering charge stings for prosecutors, since it was the one they used to paint Huawei as a criminal enterprise that lied and stole its way to the top over two decades. Huawei's lawyer, Brian Heberlig, called the acquittal a "profound rejection" of that story. The company itself says the remaining charges are just as baseless and that it will take "all necessary legal actions."
Still, some of what the jurors heard was surprisingly low-tech. Prosecutors said a Huawei worker once carried a robotic arm out of a competitor's lab so it could be photographed and measured. articles.title: Décollage d’Ariane 6 : que s’est-il passé avec l’incendie déclenché par la fusée et qui a approché une cuve d’hydrogène ?

Le Centre spatial guyanais, la base de lancement européenne de Kourou, est entouré en grande partie de savane. Lors du dixième vol d’Ariane 6, ce mardi 24 novembre, cette végétation a pris feu sous l’effet des flammes de la fusée. D’après BFMTV, l’incendie a parcouru environ cinq hectares, soit à peu près sept terrains de football. La mission s’est pourtant déroulée comme prévu : la fusée d’Arianespace a placé en orbite 36 satellites d’Amazon Leo, le réseau d’Internet par satellite d’Amazon.
Une cuve d’hydrogène sur le chemin du feu
Poussé par le vent, le feu a traversé une végétation que Péyi Guyane décrit comme très fragilisée par la sécheresse. La sécurité incendie du site est assurée par la Brigade de sapeurs-pompiers de Paris. Sur X, la brigade a expliqué que le feu menaçait « une cuve de propane et d’hydrogène liquide ». Selon France-Guyane, il a fallu six lances pour en venir à bout.
Le CNES, l’agence spatiale française qui gère la base, minimise l’incident, dans une déclaration adressée à Numerama. Pour elle, ces débuts de feu dans la savane près du pas de tir sont « un phénomène anticipé dont le risque est maîtrisé ». Elle explique qu’à chaque lancement, les pompiers arrivent les premiers sur le pas de tir pour nettoyer la zone et empêcher le feu de s’étendre. Ici, les flammes ont eu le temps de parcourir cinq hectares, jusqu’à une cuve d’hydrogène liquide. Personne n’a été blessé, et l’incendie n’a pas perturbé la mission.

The Toronto-based tech company said in a blog post published Wednesday that it detected an intrusion on November 19, in which an attacker gained access to an employee’s corporate account with GitHub, which the company uses to share and store its source code.

articles.title: Capcom Axes Live Service Game "Exoprimal" After Just 3 Years

Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Capcom Axes Live Service Game "Exoprimal" After Just 3 Years
It seems as though Sony isn't the only gaming stalwart struggling to make sense of a changing live-service gaming landscape. Exoprimal launched on Steam in July 2023 with what ought to be a convincing concept: mech suits versus dinosaurs; and it looked like Capcom had big plans for the game. However, it appears as though a compelling gameplay concept just isn't enough in a world flooded with live-service games, as the online PvP shooter failed to even crack 5,000 concurrent players on Steam. 
Now, just over three years since its launch, Capcom has announced that it will be shutting down Exoprimal for good in September 2027. Capcom has not provided a reason for the game shutting down, but it's safe to assume the low player retention is to blame. As of November 24, 2026, Exoprimal players will no longer be able to buy the Survival Pass Premium battle pass tiers. The game itself will be delisted on March 30, 2027, and the servers will shut down on September 29, 2027. There does not appear to be a post-service plan to keep the game alive at all—unlike the recently discontinued Splitgate: Arena Reloaded and Empulse, which both received a final patch allowing peer-to-peer hosting.

Erstmals konnten Forscher:innenteams des European XFEL und des DESY an der Forschungsanlage in Hamburg Röntgenlaserblitze mit einer Wellenlänge von etwa 0,04 Nanometern erzeugen und aufrechterhalten. Damit haben sie sich selbst übertroffen und ihren Rekord aus dem Jahr 2020 in den Schatten gestellt.
Laser-Meilenstein: Lichtwellen kleiner als ein Atom
Der European XFEL ist ein Röntgenlaser, der freie Elektronen (FEL, wobei das X für X-ray, also Röntgen steht) statt eines herkömmlichen Lasermediums nutzt. Um die Röntgenblitze zu erzeugen, bringt ein rund 1,7 Kilometer langer Linearbeschleuniger zunächst Elektronenpakete auf nahezu Lichtgeschwindigkeit. Die beschleunigten Elektronenpakete werden dann durch sogenannte Undulatoren auf einen Slalomkurs gezwungen. Das sind tonnenschwere Gerüste, in denen abwechselnd gepolte Magnete sitzen. Bei ihrem Slalomkurs senden die Elektronen Röntgenstrahlung aus; durch die Wechselwirkung der Strahlung mit den Elektronen selbst verstärkt sie sich zu extrem kurzen, intensiven Röntgenblitzen, die für Forschungsexperimente genutzt werden.
Der European XFEL ist eine riesige Maschine – und das nicht nur materiell: Ein Verbund von zwölf Staaten hat diese Anlage für rund 1,5 Milliarden Euro gebaut. Rund 600 Menschen arbeiten fest am XFEL. articles.title: New ReShade add-on brings ray-traced reflections to Red Dead Redemption 2 and potentially other DX12 games
articles.summary:
In context: Thanks to Doom: The Dark Ages and other recent releases, ray tracing is becoming increasingly commonplace – and even mandatory – in modern games. Meanwhile, third-party developers continue to explore ways to optimize classic games and bring modern lighting effects to older titles.
A developer named Skynizz recently unveiled the Universal Ray Tracing Injector (URTI), an add-on for ReShade designed to further improve graphics realism in PC games. URTI adds another layer of visual fidelity to the popular post-processing injector, bringing real-time ray-traced reflections to DirectX 12 games that were not originally designed to support the effect.
Skynizz explained that URTI can "capture" 3D geometry in DX12 games by replaying every draw call through the stream output. At the end of the rendering pipeline, the game should display its original geometry, including any transformations, with realistic reflections on water, puddles, glass, and other simulated surfaces.
URTI performs its work using Microsoft's official ray tracing API for DirectX 12 games, DXR 1.1. articles.title: Programmieren ja, Urteilsvermögen nein: Wo KI-Modelle an ihre Grenzen stoßen

Einige Fähigkeiten großer KI-Modelle verbessern sich weiterhin exponentiell – aber eben nicht alle. Bei Aufgaben, die Urteilsvermögen erfordern, schneiden sie beispielsweise nicht ganz so gut ab, wie beim Programmieren. Das ist ein Ergebnis eines neuen Berichts der gemeinnützigen Organisation Model Evaluation and Threat Research (METR), die an KI-Sicherheit arbeitet.
Doch das ist noch nicht einmal der spannendste Aspekt des Berichts. So liefert METR darin auch eine Aktualisierung einer sehr bekannten Zeithorizont-Grafik der Organisation, die häufig fehlinterpretiert wird. METR bewertet darin die KI-Modelle, indem die Organisation sie eine große Anzahl an Aufgaben ausführen lässt, die jeweils zuvor auch von Menschen erledigt werden konnten. Der Schwierigkeitsgrad jeder Aufgabe wurde daran gemessen, wie lange die menschlichen Tester:innen für deren Erledigung benötigten – und anschließend wurden die Modelle anhand des Zeitumfangs der Aufgaben bewertet, die sie bewältigen konnten. Die entsprechende Grafik zeigte, dass sich KI-Systeme in den vergangenen Jahren rasch verbesserten – alle vier Monate verdoppelte sich die Länge der Aufgaben, die Spitzenmodelle erfolgreich bewältigen konnten.

Los autores del estudio que se acaba de publicar reprodujeron en 3D la ciudad de Los Santos y la sometieron a dos escenarios climáticos dispuestos en el Quinto Informe del Grupo Intergubernamental de Expertos sobre el Cambio Climático (IPCC), un organismo de la ONU encargado de evaluar los conocimientos científicos sobre el cambio climático. Opensignal noted that there was a bit of a slow start, and it is now closer to the median across its OECD peers, at 52 per cent of 5G readings now using C-band. Alongside that, 32 per cent of of 5G readings are still on the AWS spectrum that previously made up a lot of Canadian 5G readings in 2023.
Adding to this, the OECD median for 5G C-band readings has fallen from 70 per cent to 58 per cent, with countries like Austria, Finland, and Sweden shifting to lower-band spectrum for better range and indoor coverage.
Secondly, all three major Canadian operators are seeing faster 5G speeds on C-band. Users on the C-band 5G get 2.0-2.8 times faster speeds than users not on C-band 5G. De un puesto a 76. Santiago Palacios Cuesta tardó 16 años en dar el salto de uno a dos puestos, luego cuatro, ocho, dieciséis y treinta y dos. articles.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia's code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
articles.summary:
When Jensen Huang gave his first all-hands address since returning as CEO, there was an odd emphasis on Nvidia’s code of conduct. He admitted to violating the code, then emphasized that no one was exempt from it. But that “does not mean, the moment you violate a code of conduct, we walk you out the door,” Huang said, according to Wired. “Facts, circumstances, a lot of assessments” still matter. In other words, the code applies to everyone, but breaking it doesn’t automatically cost anyone their job, including, apparently, the CEO.
It’s an awkward stance for a company whose CEO has admitted to breaking its rules. A central part of modern human resources, a code of conduct can seem like a quasi-legal rulebook that lays out unacceptable behavior. But experts say most codes are better understood as a reflection of corporate culture. When an infraction goes unpunished, the main risk isn’t legal but cultural — that employees will feel embarrassed or even angry about the company they work for. That’s the risk Huang now faces at Nvidia.
Matt Plass, chief market strategy officer at LRN, an ethics and compliance training outfit, recently surveyed more than 2,000 workers across different industries for a study on workplace codes of conduct. As Plass sees it, the biggest risk is that employees will become ashamed of their workplace.

articles.title: Etsy clarifies AI terms after seller backlash
articles.summary:
After backlash from sellers frustrated by Etsy’s new AI policies, which appeared to allow the company to train AI on user artwork, Etsy has now clarified its stance.
In a note published on Monday, CEO Kruti Patel Goyal discussed recent tweaks to the company’s terms of service and admitted that her team “should’ve given you more context on what the updates meant for your creative content.”
“Our recent terms update was meant to reflect the evolving technologies we’re using to build better tools and experiences for sellers and the Etsy community,” Goyal wrote this week. “It was not meant to enable us to train AI models for the purpose of creating copycats of your items. We do not and will not do that.”
Aaron Meshon, a longtime professional illustrator and Etsy seller, told Ars that even though the company had dialed back its AI language somewhat, the changes were mere “sugar coating.”
He said he still plans on shutting down his 15-year-old Etsy store on December 1.
“I would say I’m losing 20 percent of my yearly income,” he said. “It’s a few mortgage payments.”
He noted that Etsy’s announcement also seems to be rather tone-deaf, given that many retailers make a substantial portion of their annual revenue in the run-up to the end-of-year holiday season.

articles.title: AI Makes Formal Verification Practical
articles.summary:
LONDON, U.K. — Math AI foundation model startup Harmonic is expanding into formal verification for software and hardware, starting with C, Verilog, and Rust.
Formal verification is a well-known technique for proving code is correct, and when extended to hardware description languages such as Verilog, for proving hardware designs are correct and will function exactly as the specification demands. Though it’s well known, formal verification is used in a relatively limited way today, and only by specialists, Harmonic CEO Tudor Achim told EE Times.
There are two main techniques used for formal verification today. Most existing schemes use model checkers, which run the code many times over to explore all the possible states to try to find a state for which the code doesn’t behave as intended. Model checkers are powerful, but as the complexity of hardware increases, they are increasingly compute-intensive.
The other method, theorem proving, creates a logical proof that the implementation of the code is mathematically equivalent to its specification. Until now, this required humans to write proofs, and was very difficult for complex hardware.
“Historically, theorem proving has been horrible compared to model checkers,” Achim said. “Because to write a theorem proving proof, you need to write a lot of language, and to write a model checking proof you just need to solve some very specific algorithmic math problems.”

After four years of work to build a browser engine from scratch, the Ladybird project released its first downloadable alpha on November 23, offering prebuilt versions for macOS and Linux. Previously, curious users had to compile the browser themselves from its source. Now it’s an installable package with automatic updating.
Ladybird is most notable for what it isn’t: another browser fork. Where Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Opera all run on Google’s Blink engine, and Firefox depends on Gecko, Ladybird’s rendering engine and its LibJS JavaScript engine were written from scratch. “The engine is our own, built from the ground up, and not a fork,” project lead Andreas Kling wrote in Monday’s announcement. “The browser around it is modest, but functional.”
A fourth engine
Nearly the entire modern web currently runs on three browser engines. There’s WebKit (Safari), Gecko (Firefox), and the biggest of them all, Blink (Chromium). Those limited options mean that web developers often end up optimizing sites for Chromium specifically, since that’s where the majority of traffic is, and as a result, the whole web platform tends to follow suit toward whatever the dominant engine supports.

AMD Wants to Ray Trace Large, Dynamic Worlds with Reusable Parts
To scale large, open, dynamic worlds with ray tracing, AMD is developing a new approach to simplify the process. By extending traditional techniques, AMD introduces Ray Tracing Multi-Level Acceleration Structures (RT-MLAS). This technology adds additional levels of reusable acceleration structures within ray-traced objects, reducing both memory consumption and the time required to build and update them. Traditional ray tracing pipelines rely on two levels of acceleration structures: Bottom-Level Acceleration Structures (BLAS), which contain geometry, and a Top-Level Acceleration Structure (TLAS), which organizes instances of that geometry. However, large open worlds can have an enormous number of objects, making the TLAS increasingly expensive to rebuild as objects move or change their level of detail (LOD).
RT-MLAS addresses this challenge by introducing Mid-Level Acceleration Structures (MDLAS), allowing developers to organize objects into additional reusable hierarchies. AMD's implementation supports up to two additional levels, enabling repeated scene components to share acceleration structures rather than being individually duplicated or registered in an increasingly large TLAS. For example, an entire building can be represented by an MDLAS containing reusable walls, windows, doors, and roof components. articles.summary:
Euclid entdeckt bislang entferntesten Quasar – er leuchtete bereits 630 Millionen Jahre nach dem Urknall
Astronom:innen haben in Aufnahmen des europäischen Weltraumteleskops Euclid den bislang am weitesten entfernten Quasar aufgespürt. Das „Dún Aonghasa“ genannte Objekt leuchtete 630 Millionen Jahre nach dem Urknall, wie eine im Fachjournal Astronomy & Astrophysics veröffentlichte Studie zeigt.
Schweres Schwarzes Loch in der Frühzeit des Universums
Ein Quasar ist das helle Zentrum einer Galaxie, in dem ein supermassereiches Schwarzes Loch große Mengen Gas und Staub anzieht. Vor dem Verschlucken heizt sich diese Materie in einer wirbelnden Scheibe stark auf und strahlt hundert- bis tausendmal heller als die restliche Galaxie.
Im Zentrum von „Dún Aonghasa“ sitzt den Berechnungen zufolge ein Schwarzes Loch mit rund 360 Millionen Sonnenmassen. Es übertrifft das Schwarze Loch im Milchstraßenzentrum um das 90-Fache – zu einer Zeit, als der Kosmos unter fünf Prozent seines heutigen Alters lag.
Damit blickt Euclid rund 39 Millionen Jahre weiter zurück als beim bisherigen Rekordquasar vom Juli 2026, den Astronom:innen um die niederländische Universität Leiden vorstellten. Die neue Untersuchung entstand maßgeblich am Max-Planck-Institut für Astronomie in Heidelberg. Erstautor Julien Wolf wechselte inzwischen zur Europäischen Südsternwarte in Garching bei München.

articles.title: Kosmisches Pech für einen Stern – was passiert, wenn er ein Schwarzes Loch verschluckt?

MIT-Studie: Können atomgroße Schwarze Löcher ganze Sterne von innen zerstören?
Forscher:innen um den Physiker Ore Gottlieb vom Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) in Cambridge haben dieses Szenario durchgerechnet. Atomgroße Schwarze Löcher könnten demnach Sterne von innen zerstören, wie in einer im Fachjournal „The Astrophysical Journal“ veröffentlichten Studie zu lesen ist.
Gemeint sind sogenannte primordiale Schwarze Löcher, die theoretisch im ersten Sekundenbruchteil nach dem Urknall aus dichter Materie entstanden sein könnten. Anders als frühe große Schwarze Löcher im jungen Kosmos wären solche hypothetischen Objekte höchstens so groß wie ein einzelnes Atom, aber so schwer wie ein Asteroid.
Noch leichtere Exemplare hätten sich über Jahrmilliarden durch quantenmechanische Teilchenabstrahlung, die sogenannte Hawking-Strahlung, längst vollständig aufgelöst. Zwischen 100 Milliarden und 100 Billiarden Tonnen Masse bleibt dagegen eine Beobachtungslücke, in der solche Objekte die Dunkle Materie bilden könnten.
Schwerkraft von Planeten lenkt kleine Schwarze Löcher in fremde Sterne
Trifft ein solches Mini-Schwarzes-Loch im Alleingang auf einen Stern, bremst das dichte Sterngas den Eindringling wegen seiner geringen Masse kaum ab. Das Objekt durchquert den Stern einmalig mit hoher Geschwindigkeit und fliegt anschließend weiter durch den freien Weltraum.
Eingefangen wird das Schwarze Loch erst, wenn ein massereicher Planet wie Jupiter oder ein Begleitstern es per Schwerkraft…

En su lugar se llevó una ovación.

Quiénes somos nosotros, simples mortales, para enjuiciar a nuestro becerro de oro.

A modular common redundant power supply (MCRPS) has become a practical standard for enterprise server racks because it combines a compact mechanical envelope, redundancy support, and a common output interface across variants. At the same time, efficiency requirements are moving beyond traditional mid-load optimization. The result is a design environment where power density, transient response, and full-range efficiency must all be addressed together.
To target all of these requirements, Infineon Technologies has introduced a viable implementation of a 5.6 kW MCRPS design, targeting 170-W/in.3 power density and with an estimated peak PSU efficiency of >98% through a three-level flying-capacitor totem-pole power-factor-correction (PFC) stage and an isolated, GaN-based LLC converter. Integrated magnetics and advanced SiC, GaN, and silicon power devices reduce conversion losses and free valuable space for optimized cooling and component placement. An active energy buffer (EB) further supports a 12-ms holdup time while substantially reducing the required electrolytic capacitance.
AI computation is spreading across centralized data centers, enterprise infrastructure, and edge deployments. Warum eine Fassade im Job mehr belastet als hohe Eigenansprüche

Gefährdet sind laut der Untersuchung vor allem Mitarbeiter:innen, die vor wichtigen Beurteiler:innen eine makellose Fassade aufbauen und ihren Eindruck gezielt steuern wollen.
Solche Teammitglieder stellen Erfolge heraus, verschweigen Schwächen oder verbergen Fehler, weil sie Unverwundbarkeit im Berufsalltag mit Kompetenz verwechseln. articles.title: Margaret Atwood calls on feds to block telecom tower on Ontario island
articles.summary:
Margaret Atwood is urging the federal government to prohibit the construction of a telecom tower on Ontario’s Pelee Island.
The famed Canadian author of The Handmaid’s Tale is part of the Pelee Island Bird Observatory (PIBO), which argues that the proposed 600-foot tower will threaten bird safety. According to PIBO, Pelee Island “sits on a major bird migration route and within areas where critical habitat is mapped for seven species at risk.”
The group has been asking Canadians to sign a petition calling for the government to block the tower and conduct a full environmental assessment of the project. It also held a media briefing earlier today in which it noted that more than 200,000 birds in Canada are killed by communication towers annually.
DRW, the company behind the tower, told Global News that it’s using “best-in-class” technology to protect wildlife. The tower would be used for a U.S.-based company to trade data between Chicago and New Jersey. PIBO, for its part, says it has received thousands of letters of support for its pleas.
“Pelee Island is one of the stupidist [sic] places on the planet to put such a stock-trading tower,” wrote Atwood on her Substack. “It’s not a wifi tower, it would bring no communications benefits to the Island, and it would seriously tarnish the image of Pelee as a nature and birding oasis. If you wanted to kill a lot of birds with a huge, deadly tower—a LOT of birds — you couldn’t have planned it better.”
Source: PIBO Via: Global News

articles.summary:
Infineon Technologies’ CoolSET™ system-in-package (SiP) flyback controller ICs integrate the PWM controller, high-voltage switch, and high-voltage startup cell on the primary side and the system control and the synchronous-rectifier (SR) driver on the secondary side, with both sides communicating across integrated galvanic isolation.
Digital communication across integrated galvanic isolation
The primary side starts up independently from the secondary side. After startup, the secondary side takes control, and the primary side no longer performs automatic switching. This handover is communicated across the integrated galvanic isolation to the primary side, which is when the IC enters closed-loop operation.
Under the secondary side’s control, every on/off switching of the primary-side high-voltage MOSFET is initiated by the secondary side. The secondary side controls the switching frequency and the on-phase duration of the primary-side switch. The secondary side emulates current-mode control, which provides strong immunity against primary-side noise.
When the requested output power is low, the secondary side operates the primary side in burst mode, whereby the primary-side high-voltage switch temporarily ceases switching. When the output voltage of the integrated error amplifier of the secondary side reaches a certain threshold, then the primary side resumes operation.

articles.summary:
Google DeepMind AI engineers conjure mathematical proof of Signal's encryption protocol — AlphaProof Code framework powered human-bot cooperation for speedy work
Code tests are one thing, but a mathematical proof is one heck of a security blanket.
A team at Google's DeepMind AI labs has performed a complete formal proof of the code that implements the encryption mechanism for the Signal private chat application. The scientists call their procedure AlphaProof Code and claim it can be applied to other situations requiring complete end-to-end verification of computer code, meaning Signal is safe, and you can find the full paper and the code repository detailing the proof.
More explicitly, the team reviewed an Arm-compiled version of libsignal, the library that the Signal application itself incorporates and uses, with some minimal scaffolding around it. Note that the verification wasn't done against the source code: it was purposely executed against an AArch64 binary, meaning the method can be reused for future verifications of other software.
In a similar vein to the AI labs' work on mathematics, the bulk of the work was done in Lean, a purpose-built language for formal proofs. There's a key difference for this effort, though. Lean is primarily used to prove the underlying math in algorithms, which in this case would be the specifications for Signal's encryption.

Dê um toque rápido no botão PS, aquele com o logotipo da marca localizado no centro do DualSense, para abrir o Centro de Controle do PS5 na parte inferior da tela.
Use os direcionais do controle para navegar até o ícone Energia, geralmente posicionado na extremidade direita do Centro de Controle, e confirme a seleção apertando o botão X.
Escolha a opção “Desligar PS5” para desligar o PlayStation 5 com segurança e aguarde até que a luz indicadora do console pare de piscar em branco antes de removê-lo da tomada.

articles.title: Open-weight models are the hottest thing in AI. Are they right for you?
articles.summary:
Open-weight models are the hottest thing in AI. Are they right for you?
For the first three years of the generative artificial intelligence boom, enterprise technology strategy relied on a simple rule: Select the premier frontier foundation model, route every prompt through its commercial application programming interface and pay the subscription premium for access to cutting-edge technology.
That monolithic approach is now collapsing under the weight of operational reality. Open-weight models, AI models whose trained parameters, or “weights,” are publicly available for others to download, run, customize and fine-tune, are the overnight sensation in an industry already moving at light speed.
These models don’t necessarily provide access to their training data, source code or training methods. They also carry a variety of license types that may restrict how they can be used commercially. But they offer choice, flexibility and cost advantages that the leading-edge “frontier” models such as OpenAI Group PBC’s ChatGPT and Anthropic PBC’s Claude don’t. For information technology organizations, they can be a respite from spiraling token costs.
Model overkill
The popularity of these models has soared as AI has matured and organizations have realized that not every use case demands the biggest and best solution. articles.title: CNPq reformula Plataforma Lattes com novo visual
articles.summary:
CNPq reformula Plataforma Lattes com novo visual
Atualização permite localizar pesquisadores por identificadores acadêmicos e adiciona QR Code aos currículos. Base chegou a 10 milhões de perfis cadastrados.
O Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico (CNPq) lançou uma nova versão da Plataforma Lattes. A ferramenta de busca agora permite localizar pesquisadores não apenas por nome e CPF, mas também por identificadores como ORCID, ISSN e DOI.
Outra mudança está na apresentação dos currículos. Os perfis passam a contar com cartões de visita com QR Code, que facilitam o compartilhamento, além de recursos para visualizar relações acadêmicas e indicadores de produção.
A busca também ganhou filtros por modalidade de bolsa, tipo de produção acadêmica e data da última atualização do currículo. Já a página inicial agora reúne estatísticas sobre os perfis cadastrados, incluindo números de mestres, doutores e instituições.
As novidades foram anunciadas ontem (24/11) e estão sendo liberadas gradualmente para toda a base acadêmica. A plataforma reúne 10 milhões de currículos cadastrados, dos quais cerca de 2 milhões foram adicionados apenas em 2026, segundo o CNPq.
A atualização também inclui ajustes de visualização e integração com o VLibras, ferramenta que traduz conteúdos digitais para a Língua Brasileira de Sinais.
A versão anterior da plataforma continuará disponível temporariamente durante a transição. O CNPq afirma que os dados já cadastrados foram preservados.

Un commissaire de justice s’est rendu ce mercredi 25 novembre au siège de Google France pour y signifier une saisie conservatoire de 1,9 milliard d’euros. Elle est réclamée par le liquidateur de Google Russie, qui veut récupérer une partie des recettes publicitaires encaissées par Google Ireland.
Le cabinet WJ Associés, qui défend Google Russie en France, nous a confirmé la démarche. Elle vise à faire appliquer ici une condamnation prononcée à Moscou, au sujet de recettes perçues entre 2018 et 2022.
De la marge rabotée en 2018 à la saisie parisienne
Depuis 2009, Google Russie vendait les espaces publicitaires de Google Ireland et gardait 20 % du chiffre d’affaires. En 2018, cette part tombe à 3 % pour les grands comptes et à 1,5 % pour les autres clients. Selon le cabinet, ni le coût des services de Google Ireland ni la répartition du travail ne justifiaient cette baisse. Les salariés russes assuraient le même niveau de prestation. Le chiffre d’affaires de la filiale progressait, mais ses bénéfices et sa trésorerie reculaient. Elle versait aussi chaque mois à l’avance l’essentiel des sommes encaissées, sans attendre l’échéance trimestrielle. Pour WJ Associés, Google Ireland aurait cherché à fragiliser sa filiale.
Google a suspendu ses ventes publicitaires en Russie en mars 2022. Google Russie a été déclarée en faillite en 2023 et a fermé son bureau de Moscou, où travaillaient 224 personnes. En octobre 2023, nous rapportions que la justice russe avait officialisé cette faillit…

articles.summary:
The state of China's memory industry in 2026 — CXMT and YMTC are booming, but HBM remains a headache
A record year for Chinese memory, while Huawei ships its own HBM without a named source.
China’s homegrown memory comes largely from two companies, CXMT for DRAM and YMTC for 3D NAND, and both are booming. CXMT’s Oct. 30 quarterly report shows a nine-month net profit of ¥132.0 billion ($19.6 billion), against a ¥5.28 billion ($785 million) loss a year earlier, on revenue more than eight times as high, at ¥269.0 billion ($40.0 billion). YMTC’s numbers, just for Q1, are at ¥47.04 billion ($7.0 billion) in revenue and ¥33.38 billion ($5.0 billion) in profit attributable to shareholders, more than double 2025.
Both are expanding and adding fabs, and each is edging into the other’s products. No Chinese manufacturer can yet produce high-bandwidth memory (HBM) in volume, though. HBM is the stacked DRAM that AI accelerators depend on, and currently the U.S. bars Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron from selling it into China. CXMT’s prospectus lists no HBM project, though its HBM3E is reportedly in risk production, an early run before the process is fully qualified. Huawei designs its own HBM but doesn’t say who makes it.
Memory is a commodity, so the story is in the wafers. We cover the companies running memory fabs in China: CXMT, YMTC, a handful of smaller Chinese fabs, and Samsung and SK hynix, which run some of their biggest plants there. Huawei makes the cut for its HBM program, though…

articles.title: Siempre nos han dicho que parar 15 minutos a hacer ejercicio mejora el estudio. La ciencia dice que no es tan sencillo
articles.summary:
Cuando nos ponemos a estudiar delante de un tocho de apuntes, es fácil que al rato la concentración comience a flaquear. En este caso, levantarse de la silla para hacer 15 minutos de ejercicio moderado es algo que siempre nos han dicho que puede despejarnos y mejorar el rendimiento académico. El problema es que no es tan fácil.
La base. Uno de los pilares habituales para defender los descansos activos viene de un ensayo publicado en 2014. En este un grupo de investigadores evaluó a 123 niños de entre 10 y 11 años de cuatro colegios de primaria tras hacer una hora de deberes. De este modo, cada estudiante pasó por cuatro escenarios distintos: seguir sin pausa, hacer un descanso pasivo, realizar 15 minutos de actividad física moderada o hacer 15 minutos de ejercicio vigoroso.
El resultado determinó que la mejora cognitiva más marcada se daba en el grupo de niños que habían hecho una actividad moderada. Por contra, el ejercicio vigoroso arrojó resultados similares a los que se vieron en hacer un simple descanso pasivo, seguramente por la fatiga que genera.
Tiene sentido. Para explicar cómo el movimiento puede ayudar a fijar todo lo que se ha estudiado, se suele recurrir a un estudio de 2021 donde se analizó todo lo que ocurría en el cerebro cuando se estaba haciendo bicicleta estática. Aquí los investigadores observaron que tanto el ejercicio moderado como el intenso elevaban los niveles de BDNF del cerebro y de anandamida, un endocannabinoide implicado en la plasticidad sinápti…

articles.title: Attacker used 1Password employee's GitHub account to copy customer records
articles.summary:
Attacker used 1Password employee’s GitHub account to copy customer records
Identity security company 1Password today disclosed a security incident in which an attacker, working through an employee’s corporate GitHub account, copied account records belonging to a subset of its customers.
According to the company, the incident came to light on Nov. 19, when 1Password began investigating signs that the GitHub account had been compromised. Using the account, the attacker is said to have pushed malicious code to 1Password’s backend services, which then downloaded what the company describes as “administrative data pertaining to our customers.”
The records taken include names and email addresses, account and user identifiers, account creation and last sign-in times, public keys, Secure Remote Password protocol parameters and other non-secret account metadata. Rounding out the list are tokens found in certain emailed links for invitations, provisioning and account recovery.
Customer vaults, the items stored in them and the keys that protect them were not affected, according to 1Password. “At no time were customer vault contents accessed by, or available to, the attacker,” the company said in its disclosure. Account passwords and Secret Keys are not stored by the company. Also left untouched, the company says, were account recovery keys and the 1Password apps and browser extensions.

articles.title: Samsung and SK hynix to License YMTC's Xtacking Technology
articles.summary:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Samsung and SK hynix to License YMTC's Xtacking Technology
According to Nikkei Asia, South Korea's largest chipmakers are currently looking to license technology from China's YMTC. Specifically, SK hynix and Samsung are exploring ways to integrate YMTC's highly successful Xtacking silicon 3D NAND design. In the fourth iteration of Xtacking, YMTC can separate memory cell wafers from peripheral logic circuits and combine them using hybrid bonding wafer-to-wafer stacking. Hybrid bonding creates a permanent bond between two silicon chips using embedded metal bumps that are fused together to form a single chip. Multiple dies or entire silicon wafers can be connected by stacking the back ends of two chips together, and SK hynix and Samsung see this as a potential way to advance their 3D NAND production.
Since 2019, YMTC has been manufacturing using Xtacking technology, now on version 4.0. Samsung told Nikkei Asia that this bonding technology offers numerous advantages over the current approach to building many-layer NAND flash. SK hynix and Samsung are building NAND with hundreds of layers but are hitting single-wafer limitations. YMTC's technology has been refined and production-tested, making it easier for Samsung and SK hynix to switch to it. Additionally, YMTC has filed more than 4,000 patents related to 3D memory production, packaging, and more since 2018. articles.title: SK hynix to Start 3D DRAM Production in 2031
articles.summary:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
SK hynix to Start 3D DRAM Production in 2031
SK hynix is planning to begin mass production of next-generation 3D DRAM by 2031, confirmed Choi Kang-sik, a Distinguished Engineer at SK hynix, during the AI Semiconductor Forum at Seoul National University in Gwanak-gu. According to the presentation, SK hynix's roadmap indicates that 3D DRAM production could start in 4 to 5 years, which would place the timeline at the latest in 2031. SK hynix estimates that 3D DRAM would require approximately 75 memory layers to match the memory density of today's leading-edge 1c DRAM, which utilizes a 10 nm class design. Considering other factors, the company aims to develop a 100-layer design as a first-generation product to ensure it represents a significant advancement over the planar DRAM it has been manufacturing for years.
Current equipment can reportedly handle 100 layers of 3D DRAM, but achieving 200 to 300-layer DRAM would require multi-deck stacking and specialized hybrid bonding techniques, adapted from 3D NAND flash, to reach higher densities. SK hynix is expected to adopt this technology from the Chinese company YMTC and license its Xtacking technology. Xtacking hybrid bonding creates a permanent bond between two silicon chips using embedded metal bumps that are fused together to form a single chip. Los expertos en ciberseguridad advierten que la urgencia suele ser el principal recurso de los estafadores. Descuentos fuera de lo habitual, relojes que anuncian el fin de una promoción o mensajes sobre supuestos problemas con una entrega pueden impulsar decisiones apresuradas.
Por esta razón, antes de pagar, se debe comparar precios, revisar las condiciones de venta y acceder a los comercios desde sus direcciones oficiales.
Cómo saber si un comercio en línea es falsa
Una tienda fraudulenta puede reproducir el diseño, los logotipos y las imágenes de un comercio legítimo. La diferencia suele aparecer en detalles de la dirección web: una letra cambiada, un dominio inusual o una extensión distinta de la oficial.
El Instituto Nacional de Ciberseguridad de España (INCIBE) sugiere escribir la dirección del comercio en el navegador en lugar de ingresar a través de enlaces recibidos por correo, mensajes de texto o redes sociales.

Décidément, l’imagination des développeurs n’a pas de limites : un projet open source, win4wine, est parvenu à remplacer l’interface de Debian 13… par celle du vénérable Windows XP.
Windows XP a beau avoir plus de 25 ans, il n’est toujours pas prêt à prendre sa retraite. Il y a un peu plus d’un mois, on apprenait que Windows 11 s’était inspiré du système pour sa barre de tâches. Un peu plus tôt cette année, un utilisateur de Reddit avait réussi à marier la célèbre colline verte de Windows XP à l’esthétique de Windows 11 pour un résultat tout simplement impressionnant. Cette fois, la nostalgie gagne aussi les amateurs d’open source.
Un développeur ressuscite explorer.exe sur Linux
Les thèmes façon Windows existent depuis bien longtemps sous Linux. Mais le développeur japonais mikuta0407 a eu une idée encore plus originale : il est parvenu à exécuter l’explorateur de fichiers de Windows XP directement dans Debian.
Comment a-t-il réussi ce tour de force ? En modifiant la version 11.0 de Wine, un logiciel Linux qui permet de faire tourner des applications Windows : 151 correctifs ont été, en tout, nécessaires. Le résultat, qui a été publié sur GitHub sous le nom de win4wine, est bluffant : on retrouve la barre des tâches du système d’antan, mais aussi son menu Démarrer et ses fenêtres.
Même les logiciels Linux se fondent dans le décor : leurs fenêtres héritent du look propre à XP, leurs icônes côtoient celles de Windows et les boutons d'agrandissement ou de réduction se comporten…

Alors que Jim Brennan attendait une commande Amazon livrée par drone, l'engin s'est tout simplement écrasé sur le garage de son voisin. L'appareil a percuté un câble de fibre optique juste après avoir remis le colis. Une histoire qui a eu lieu à Huntington Woods, dans la banlieue nord de Detroit. Désormais, la FFA, autorité étasunienne de l'aviation civile, enquête sur l'accident.
Nous sommes vendredi dernier quand Jim Brennan attend un flacon de shampoing commandé par sa femme. Une notification l'a prévenu que le colis arrivait en drone, une première pour la famille qui n'a jamais été livrée par un engin pareil. Mais tout ne s'est pas passé comme prévu.
Un drone Amazon qui s'écrase sur un garage
Vers 16h30, le drone MK30 d'Amazon a lâché le colis dans le jardin arrière puis a heurté le câble tendu au-dessus de sa trajectoire lors de la remontée. "Quand il a accroché ce fil, il est parti dans tous les sens", a décrit Jim Brennan.
L'engin a perdu une hélice dans le choc.
Instable, le drone s'est ensuite emmêlé dans un branchement électrique, la ligne qui relie un poteau à une habitation. Le drone MK30 s'est immobilisé entre ce câble et le toit du garage de Logan Coomes, un voisin de 30 ans.

GTA 6 é mais estável no Xbox que no PlayStation
Comparativo da Digital Foundry aponta quedas de desempenho mais frequentes no PlayStation padrão. PS5 Pro, por outro lado, oferece a melhor apresentação visual.
GTA 6 apresenta quedas de desempenho mais frequentes no PS5 padrão do que no Xbox Series X, segundo uma comparação da Digital Foundry. Os dois consoles miram os 30 quadros por segundo (fps), mas o aparelho da Microsoft consegue sustentar esse patamar com mais regularidade. 
A vantagem do Series X sobre o PlayStation convencional aparece principalmente na estabilidade, já que as configurações visuais das duas versões são muito próximas. O Pro, por sua vez, é o console que oferece a melhor apresentação no geral. A análise compara também PS5 Pro e Xbox Series S. 
Nos testes, PS5 padrão e Series X mantêm 30 fps durante boa parte da experiência. As quedas são mais frequentes no PlayStation ao dirigir rapidamente e em áreas com multidões. O console da Microsoft também apresenta oscilações. As medições apontam resolução interna de 1440p nos dois aparelhos, com configurações parecidas de iluminação global e reflexos por ray tracing.
Outro ponto favorável ao Series X é a combinação de saída de 120 Hz com VRR, sigla para taxa de atualização variável. Em telas compatíveis, o recurso ajuda a suavizar a apresentação quando o desempenho oscila. Isso não significa que GTA 6 rode a 120 fps, o alvo permanece em 30 fps. articles.title: Quatre hommes jugés à Nancy pour de faux placements crypto
articles.summary:
Une centaine de victimes, en majorité des particuliers démarchés par téléphone, auraient perdu environ quatre millions d'euros dans de faux placements en cryptomonnaies et en diamants. Mardi, à Nancy, le parquet a demandé jusqu'à douze ans de prison contre les quatre hommes jugés dans cette affaire.
En 2014, la cour d'appel de Paris a condamné Fabrice Sakoun à sept ans de prison pour une escroquerie à la taxe carbone, une affaire où la justice voyait en lui le « cerveau ». Ce Franco-Israélien de 53 ans vit aujourd'hui en Israël, et l'accusation le soupçonne d'avoir commandé une nouvelle arnaque, menée en France et en Belgique entre 2017 et 2018. Le procureur Vincent Legaut a requis contre lui douze ans de prison et 750 000 euros d'amende devant la Juridiction interrégionale spécialisée (Jirs) de Nancy, un pôle de magistrats chargé de la criminalité organisée. Les quatre prévenus sont présumés innocents, et le tribunal rendra son jugement le 9 décembre. Pour entrer dans l'arnaque, les victimes versaient d'abord 500 euros.
Les escrocs réclamaient toujours plus d'argent avant de couper le contact
Au téléphone, un prétendu conseiller promettait de gros rendements, puis il orientait la victime vers de faux sites d'investissement en cryptomonnaies ou en diamants. Après la première mise de 500 euros, il organisait chaque semaine des séances de trading avec elle, pendant plusieurs mois. Et les victimes continuaient à investir. articles.title: IA cria arquitetura de CPU quase 4,6 vezes mais eficiente
articles.summary:
IA cria arquitetura de CPU quase 4,6 vezes mais eficiente
Projeto Frostbite, da startup Architect Labs, superou um núcleo convencional em simulações de 25 programas. Desempenho precisa ser confirmado em hardware real.
A startup Architect Labs afirma que agentes de inteligência artificial criaram uma arquitetura de CPU com eficiência energética quase 4,6 vezes maior que a de um núcleo convencional usado como referência. Batizado de Frostbite, o projeto alcançou esse resultado em simulações, segundo dados divulgados pela empresa.
O número representa desempenho por watt: quanto trabalho o processador entrega em relação à potência consumida. O projeto chegou ao desenho físico dos circuitos, mas ainda não foi fabricado para confirmar o consumo real.
O resultado é uma média geométrica dos ganhos proporcionais em 25 programas. Dez foram usados durante a otimização, com vantagem de 6,02 vezes. Nos outros 15, reservados para a avaliação final, o ganho foi de 3,83 vezes.
A comparação também exige atenção à referência. A empresa colocou um conjunto de quatro unidades menores do Frostbite contra um único núcleo convencional semelhante, ambos projetados para 7 nanômetros. O núcleo concorrente não teve a identidade divulgada.
Esses resultados não significam que o chip seja quatro vezes mais rápido em qualquer programa ou que supere nessa proporção os processadores de PCs atuais.

Segundo uma reportagem recente da Reuters, a revisão foi motivada por incidentes em testes da OpenAI com modelos que driblaram restrições de segurança.

Conhecidos como kill switches, esses mecanismos servem para desconectar agentes que apresentem falhas ou tenham sido comprometidos. Como o desligamento pode afetar as operações bancárias, as instituições testam alternativas para atividades como detecção de fraudes. O objetivo é manter os serviços funcionando enquanto o agente fica suspenso.
Os bancos também restringem permissões, separam os ambientes de testes das operações diárias e limitam o tempo de atividade dos agentes. Senhas e registros de atividade são mantidos fora do alcance desses sistemas.
Os agentes de IA conseguem planejar etapas, utilizar ferramentas e executar tarefas. Em um ambiente bancário, essa capacidade exige definir quais informações cada ferramenta pode acessar. L'empêcheur de tourner en rond. Des policiers de onze pays ont passé cinq jours à Séville, au siège de la police nationale espagnole, du 16 au 20 novembre, sous la coordination d'Europol. Ils ont enquêté sur l'argent de l'IPTV pirate, ces offres de télévision par Internet qui donnent accès à des milliers de chaînes, au sport en direct et aux films pour quelques euros par mois, sans l'accord des ayants droit. D'après le communiqué d'Europol, l'opération a perturbé 57 services et permis de repérer 321 sites de diffusion illégale, qui totalisent plus de 7,3 millions de visites par an. Les polices nationales doivent encore mettre un nom sur les personnes qui encaissent cet argent.
Europol suit l'argent des abonnés jusqu'aux portefeuilles des pirates
En février, Europol avait soutenu l'opération Switch Off, qui a fermé trois grandes plateformes pirates en Italie. Mais l'agence européenne s'attaque davantage aux paiements, car fermer un service n'arrête pas forcément les criminels qui le dirigent. Pour Europol, l'IPTV pirate est « un marché criminel pesant des milliards d'euros par an ». articles.title: Hackers Exploited CVSS 10.0 Hex.pm RCE Flaw to Compromise 6 Package Registry Servers
articles.summary:
An attacker ran operating system commands on Monday on six production servers of Hex.pm, the package registry that Elixir and Erlang developers fetch their dependencies from.
The flaw used in the attack had been in the registry's code since February 2016, and the team that maintains the service had every server on a patched build within about 15 minutes of the first malicious request.
Checks since then found no sign that any package was changed. Whether the attacker read account data such as email addresses, password hashes, and two-factor authentication secrets could not be ruled out, the team said.
What Hex Users Should Do Now
Everyone with a hex.pm account has been logged out because the maintainers replaced the keys that sign sessions and access tokens. They advise account holders to take these steps:
- Change your hex.pm password.
- Reset two-factor authentication by setting up a new authenticator entry, and store the new recovery codes.
- Log back in to the client with mix hex.user auth or, for Erlang projects, rebar3 hex user auth.
- Update the Hex client when the next release ships, expected within days, with a new registry signing system.
- Watch for phishing. Exposed email addresses may be misused, so check that links in any email about Hex go to hex.pm.

- CVE-2026-129243 (CVSS score: 8.8) - An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to invoke OWS operations that are otherwise protected by service security rules.

Ses équipes sont « mobilisées pour rétablir le service dans les meilleurs délais ». Pas plus d'infos donc, à ce stade, sur les causes ni même sur le calendrier d'une éventuelle résolution.

articles.title: Phision shows off a new SSD design with its own NPU and 64GB of memory — which it says can cut data transfers by 10 to 100 times
articles.summary:
Phision shows off a new SSD design with its own NPU and 64GB of memory — which it says can cut data transfers by 10 to 100 times
Phison's new SSD design packs an NPU and 64GB memory
- Phison detailed an unnamed SSD architecture at SC26 with an integrated NPU rated at 36,800 DMIPS and 64GB of memory at 130GB/s
- It claims on-drive filtering could cut data transfers by 10 to 100 times for suitable workloads while also taking load off CPUs
- There is no product name, controller, power figure, price, or date yet; Phison says the design is still in development
Phison wants enterprise SSDs to stop acting purely as warehouses and start doing some of the sorting themselves.
At the recent Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) event, the company detailed a computational storage architecture that places an integrated NPU and 64GB of memory with 130GB/s of bandwidth inside the drive.
This marks a break from the usual modus operandi: Rather than shipping entire datasets across PCIe to a host CPU or GPU, the drive is meant to scan and process data in parallel where it already sits, then send back only the relevant results, an approach that Phison says could potentially reduce data transfers by 10 to 100 times while freeing up host CPU resources.
A large claim, with a large caveat?
